import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

# Try a PNG with a huge IDAT length but truncated data to stress read_header/read_chunk_bytes.
sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# Manually craft IDAT with declared length larger than actual payload.
length=struct.pack('>I', 0x1000)
type_=b'IDAT'
payload=zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00')[:2]
crc=struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(type_+payload)&0xffffffff)
trunc_idat=length+type_+payload+crc
poc=sig+ihdr+trunc_idat
pathlib.Path('trunc_idat.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
PY
